research_metadata.research_title: Sheep and Goat Rearing Feasibility in Kalaburagi Rural - Aland, Afzalpur, Jevargi/Jewargi, Kalaburagi

business_profile.business_model: Production and sale of live animals, meat, manure, wool and skins
business_profile.description: Sheep and goat rearing is rearing of Deccani, Osmanabadi and local breeds for meat, wool, manure and breeding stock sale. Activity is low-investment, suitable for small-marginal farmers and landless labourers, requires grazing land, dry fodder, and basic sheds. Gestation 5 months, 1-2 kids/lambs per kidding, 1.5 kiddings per year. Income from sale of male kids/lambs, cull animals, manure, gunny bags, wool.

rural_suitability.reason: Kalaburagi district has 3.7 lakh goats and 1 lakh sheep per 2012 census, vast grazing tracts, traditional shepherd communities, 27 sheep/goat cooperative societies and established shandies. NABARD specifically identified Afzalpur and Aland for ADS sheep/goat scheme.

comparison_table.Kalaburagi: Medium-High - higher land cost but best infrastructure

taluk_comparison.recommendation_reason: Kalaburagi taluk has highest goat population 63718, district headquarters with 2000 animal APMC main yard Saturday, 1 polyclinic + 29 hospitals + 97 dispensaries sufficient per NABARD, best road/rail connectivity to Hyderabad/Solapur, and year-round urban demand reducing seasonality. seasonality.low_period: March to May summer fodder scarcity and heat stress
seasonality.reason: Green fodder scarcity in summer, heat stress 44.5C impacts fertility, and festival-driven demand spike. Dry fodder abundant Oct-Feb.
seasonality.business_impact: Feed cost increases 20-30% in summer, kidding rate may drop in extreme heat, sale price premium 20-30% during Bakrid
mitigation: Fodder museum 1 acre 10 varieties with subsidy
Silage making, hay storage from Oct-Feb
Plan kidding to avoid peak summer

financial_model.calculation_methodology: Monthly Revenue = (kids sold per year /12 * price) + manure + gunny. For 20+1: 30 kids born per 6 months =60 per year, 80% survival =48, sell 40 @6500 =260000 but NABARD cash flow shows 163000 in year II due to retention for replacement - used NABARD conservative 163000 per year /12=13583. Expenses = feed does 2948*20 + buck 165 + kids 2034*~20 + medicines 2100 + misc 3000 + insurance annualized. Profit = revenue - expenses. Break-even = investment / monthly profit. For small scale investment 110k /3500=31 months.

Dependence on rainfall 842mm for fodder, borewell water scarcity in summer

opportunities: Growing demand for meat locally as well as from other states per NABARD ADS opportunity, per capita consumption gap 3.06 vs 4.45 kg

Amrita Swabhimani Kurigahi 20+1 unit at Rs 1,75,000 with 50% NCDC loan, 25% state grant, 25% beneficiary

Decline in shepherding occupation in irrigated patches due to scarcity of grazing lands per Karnataka meat market study
Competition from large traders importing from other districts

seven_day_validation_experiment.objective: Validate sheep/goat rearing demand, supply, pricing and unit economics in target taluk before investing

days.activity: Visit APMC markets Kalaburagi Saturday 2000 capacity, Aland Thursday, Jewargi everyday, Afzalpur Wednesday and count animals traded, note price per kg live
days.target: Visit 2 markets, interview 5 shepherds and 3 traders
days.measurement: Number of animals traded, average price Rs/kg, breed preference

days.activity: Interview potential customers - 5 butchers/meat shops, 5 farmers wanting breeding stock, 2 restaurants
days.measurement: Willingness to pay, monthly demand kg, preferred weight 15-20kg sheep 35kg goat

days.activity: Contact suppliers - feed dealers Kalaburagi Shahbad Road, veterinary dispensary for vaccine cost, animal breeders in Rajapur, Bellary, Latur
days.target: Get 3 quotations for 10+1 and 20+1 animals, feed cost per month, insurance 4-7.5%
days.measurement: Supplier price, feed Rs/month, insurance quote

days.activity: Test product - visit 2 existing small farms Family Goat Farm Rajapur and Shirwal farm, observe shed size 6 sq ft covered 20 sq ft open, feeding practice
days.measurement: Mortality rate, kidding interval, litter size observed

days.activity: Attempt actual sales/pre-orders - offer 2-3 kids/lambs from neighbour farmer at shandy or via WhatsApp group to butchers
days.measurement: Number of interested buyers, price offered vs expected 6500, time to sell

days.activity: Calculate unit economics using NABARD cash flow template - income sale of male kids 81000 per 6 months, female kids 81000, expenses feed 5100, vet 2100, insurance 6900 annualized
days.measurement: Monthly profit, break-even months, working capital need

days.activity: Make decision - Proceed if >10 interested customers, supplier quotations within NABARD cost 1.1-1.9 lakh, expected monthly profit >3500 for 10+1, insurance available

success_criteria: At least 10 customer interviews with >60% intent to buy
2 supplier quotations within 10% of NABARD cost
At least 3 pre-orders or sales in day 5
Mortality <10% observed in existing farms with vaccination
Feed availability confirmed for summer months
failure_criteria: Animal cost >30% above NABARD unit cost 5500-6000 per female
No insurance or veterinary support in taluk
Feed cost >150% of NABARD estimate 2948 per doe per year
seven_day_validation_experiment.decision_rule: Proceed if demand medium-high and input availability high and competition medium and break-even <60 months. Modify to small 10+1 if capital limited or to Jewargi/Kalaburagi if Aland water scarcity high. Do Not Proceed if mortality >15% or no market access within 15km.

government_schemes.scheme_selection_method: Select the five most relevant currently applicable schemes based on verified business eligibility and financial relevance. Chosen 5 unique: NLM-EDP 50% up to 50 lakh national, PMEGP 15-35% national, Amrita Swabhimani 20+1 state, KSWDC 6+1 90% SC/ST state, Pashu Bhagya credit linked state. Women benefits extracted from NLM and PMEGP and state cooperative membership.

capital_and_financing.recommended_funding_pathway: Small 10+1: Own contribution 10% Rs 11000 + bank loan 90% Rs 99000 from RRB/Karnataka Grameena Bank refinance from NABARD LTRCF concessional. Insurance 7.5% for 3 years. For SC/ST: Apply KSWDC 6+1 90% subsidy Rs 40500 subsidy own Rs 4500. For medium 20+1: Kalaburagi ADS loan Rs 171000 bank loan 90% margin 20000, apply Pashu Bhagya 25-33% subsidy via cooperative bank. For large 100+5: Apply NLM-EDP online nlm.udyamimitra.in for 50% subsidy up to 50 lakh, bank term loan remaining 50% with CGTMSE guarantee, own contribution 10%. Women: PMEGP 35% rural subsidy own contribution 5%.
capital_and_financing.important_distinction: Business investment and government-scheme own contribution are different concepts.

final_feasibility.strongest_reason_to_consider: Kalaburagi district is 3rd top goat district in Karnataka with 372951 goats 2012 and 630311 goats 13.14% of state per scholarsresearchlibrary, meat production low rank 24-25th indicates supply gap, 2000 animal capacity main APMC Saturday, best veterinary infrastructure 207 institutions, urban demand 5.43 lakh city plus connectivity to Hyderabad and Solapur for Osmanabadi premium.
final_feasibility.biggest_risk: Summer fodder scarcity March-May and heat stress 44.5C causing fertility drop and feed cost rise 20-30%
final_feasibility.minimum_viable_startup: 10+1 unit Rs 1.1 lakh with 10% own contribution Rs 11000 and 90% bank loan, or 6+1 SC/ST unit Rs 45000 with 90% subsidy own Rs 4500 via KSWDC
final_feasibility.recommended_scale_for_beginner: Small 10+1 to 20+1 stall-fed with grazing, learn for 1 year then scale to 100+5 with NLM 50% subsidy
final_feasibility.recommended_validation_before_investment: 7-day market validation: visit Kalaburagi APMC Saturday and Jewargi everyday, interview 15 customers butchers and farmers, get 3 supplier quotes for Osmanabadi does at Rs 5500-6000, confirm insurance and mobile vet helpline 1962 availability
final_feasibility.loan_readiness: High - NABARD refinance from LTRCF at concessional rate for Cooperatives and RRBs for sheep/goat, PMEGP no collateral up to Rs 10 lakh, KCC animal husbandry loan up to Rs 1.6 lakh without security, NLM 50% subsidy reduces loan burden

major_data_gaps: Taluk-level current livestock census 20th census 2019 district-level not published taluk-wise - used 2012 census from NABARD ADS
Udyam registered sheep/goat businesses taluk-level not publicly accessible - used NABARD and local search
Exact current market prices for live weight in Kalaburagi APMC not published online - estimated Rs 300-400/kg based on Karnataka benchmarks
Competitor counts incomplete database - identified based on available NABARD and Meta places
